Noah Vega: Quick kickoff for Solstice Retail onboarding — planned start Mon 2026-08-03. We need stakeholder contacts, 14-day success criteria, task owners, and any renewal/procurement flags. @Tara Mitchell @Ibrahim Khan @Luna Park

Tara Mitchell: On intake: Priya V. (Product), Marco G. (Infra), Dana L. (Data). Finance contact TBD. CSM flagged a procurement checkpoint in ~37 days — mark as potential renewal risk. :warning:

Ibrahim Khan: I'll own infra setup and SLA exceptions. Need expected token/day profile and network contact for on-prem firewall rules. I'll post a short form to collect values.

Luna Park: I'll run enablement (30m). Plan: 20m console + common errors, 10m Q&A. Prefer mornings; will send agenda and poll. I'll include a 3-question feedback form.

Noah Vega: Draft 14-day success metrics: 1) Staging E2E smoke with median gen latency <180ms; 2) 12 representative prompts meet quality gate (<=4% failures); 3) 3 engineers with console access & able to run tests; 4) billing baseline & cost estimate delivered; 5) basic observability dashboards in console. Any objections?

Tara Mitchell: Add: pin model to rw-stable (v1.3.1) for rollout stability, and require a data privacy attestation if samples contain PII.

Ibrahim Khan: I'll collect infra inputs and prepare the 14-day health template (KPIs: p50/p95, 5xx rate, quality pass %, infra blockers). I'll draft by day 11.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Solstice - Enablement" Thu 2026-08-06 16:00 UTC — https://calendar.example/evt/solstice-001 :calendar:

Luna Park: Pre-onboard checklist I'll ask customers to complete: - create service account + API key - provide IP allowlist - upload sample payloads/schema - grant console access for 3 engineers - share sanitized prompt set

Noah Vega: Who will take the renewal signal row? We should track procurement date, exec sponsor engagement, and budget signoff owner.

Tara Mitchell: I'll own the Renewal Signals entry and add mitigation actions (exec intro, weekly usage digest, cost scenario analysis).

Ibrahim Khan: Also: Omar (Infra) asked for an initial throughput cap plan; I'll include recommended caps and fallback routing notes.

Noah Vega: Great. Cadence: enablement Thu, quick go/no-go Fri. I'll update the onboarding playbook and tag owners. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
